Fixes #NNN

## Purpose

Why this change: the problem from the issue, in a sentence or two.

## Approach

What the PR changes, and any calls made within the issue's agreement.

## Impact

What changes on users' machines: the extensions touched, the contribution points involved and when they run, and the manifest `version` bump (or why there is none).

## Testing

How it was tested, and what wasn't.

Keep private details (people, companies, internal systems, incidents) out of the description and the commit messages: the repository is public. See [How a PR gets to merge](https://github.com/mnemcik/cg-extensions#how-a-pr-gets-to-merge).
